Search verdict — Girl with a Pearl Earring, background removed

Base fixed: signed-damage dw=0.5 cw=0.5 agree=0.90. You supplied the two photos with blank black backgrounds so the algorithm ignores them — so I recoloured the black to white (which subject_mask excludes), concentrating all shards and metrics on the girl (~40% of canvas). Primary pair: front/back girl. Second pair: apples/breakfast.

Objective ordering (strict, not averaged)

  1. Hard gates: completeness ≥85% both walls, total shards ≤300.
  2. Primary: recognizability (SSIM+edge).
  3. Secondary: minimise cryptic carry.
  4. Tiebreak: fewer shards.

Removing the background fixed the reliability problem

Every candidate now passes the gate 6/6 seeds (vs the background-included version that needed K=32 and still only hit 5/6). K=16 is sufficient — the girl-only subject makes placement easy. Shard counts are tiny (~60-200, far under cap). This is the cleanest, most reliable result of the whole search.

Winner by the strict objective: 16 panels · ~65 shards (mult 0.3) · K=16

gate 6/6, primary 1.284±0.046, carry 0.394±0.069 (most cryptic), fewest shards. Multi-seed validated, not a lucky seed.

The honest caveat: the recognizability metric is inflated, and it hid a real effect

The headline "SSIM 0.42 → 0.76" is partly an artifact: with the background now white in both render and target (62% of canvas), that matching white inflates full-image SSIM. Measuring the girl only: RMSE ≈ 0.25 — soft, similar to before. The girl reads as a recognizable soft shard-mosaic (turban, gold garment, figure), not a crisp face.

And the metric misled the objective: girl-only RMSE keeps improving with more shards (0.252 → 0.235 going 61 → 192 shards), and you can SEE the face sharpen below — but full-image SSIM stayed flat, so the strict objective under-valued shard count and picked the fewest (65). If you care about the girl looking good — which is the point — use MORE shards (~190), not 65. The trade: less cryptic, more pieces, but a visibly better girl.

Winner config at different shard counts — pick crispness vs simplicity by eye

(Display is vertically flipped, but render and target are flipped identically.) 65 shards = blobby but recognizable; ~190-365 = the face and garment folds sharpen noticeably.

Top-3 — shadows (cols 1-2) + one panel ALONE (cols 3-4)

Busiest single panel: winner 28-29% < runner-up 32-43% < current config 49-53% — the winner is genuinely the most cryptic (no single panel gives the girl away).

Validation

Multi-seed: all candidates 6/6 — trustworthy, not seed-lucky. Second pair (apples/breakfast): winner gate 5/5, primary 1.408 (strong) — transfers.

Recommendation

If crypticness + minimal build is the priority: 16 panels, ~65 shards, K=16 (strict winner). If the girl looking as good as possible is the priority: same 16 panels but ~190 shards — girl-only fidelity is measurably better and it still passes everything comfortably. Either way, remove the background (done) and use 16 panels.
